summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 7,000,000 ordinary shares on July 13, 2026, under its existing share buyback program. The shares were bought from Goldman Sachs International at prices ranging from 110.45 to 112.55 pence per share, with a volume-weighted average of 111.2086 pence. Purchases are conducted under the program announced January 30, 2026; shares will be canceled. This is a routine open-market buyback, not a tender offer. In a U.S. context, such filings are analogous to an issuer share repurchase disclosure. Watch for ongoing buyback pace and capital return consistency.
